note: The director's frozen Wave-2 agenda, as DATA. The foundation declarations below are the data-foundation-agent's, universe-construction-agent's and feature-library-agent's; preregistration.py applies them through the pipeline in the one order the pipeline admits. Nothing here is a result.
safety: RESEARCH ONLY. PAPER ONLY. NO ORDERS, NO FILLS, NO PROMOTION, NO ADOPTION. NEW_PAID_DATA_COST = $0.

datasets.availability_rule: Index s is session s; nothing is forward filled. A decision at t reads price, return and term-structure slope through t-1 and volume and open interest through t-2, because the newest volume row is provisional and open interest is published one session late. A market that did not trade on a grid session is NaN, never carried forward.
datasets.survivorship: Expired dated contracts are retained; the layer is the dated-contract record, not a back-adjusted continuation. 68 markets, manifest-listed and sha256-verified at load; the orphan FGBL.csv is excluded by the R57-repaired owner and can no longer enter a measured result.
datasets.notes: Per-market cost_bps_per_side is MODELLED_NOT_OBSERVED (2-15 bp per side), not a measured fill. Eight Wave-2 cells price on that model, so cost_robust (the doubled-cost attack) is load-bearing here, not routine.

datasets.availability_rule: Whole-curve open interest summed over every listed contract, usable through t-2 (OI_LATEST_USABLE_OFFSET = 2).
datasets.survivorship: Every listed contract of a market is summed, including expired ones; reconciles to CFTC COT with median ratio 1.000.
datasets.notes: MEASURED coverage in the 2011-07-01 window: 100% of commodity own sessions, 0% outside commodities, 57.1% overall. Certified for COMMODITY_FUTURES ONLY, which is why the cross-asset churn cell (W2-04) uses the FRONT contract's open interest and says so.

datasets.availability_rule: Total-return closes through t; the book enters at the close of t+1.
datasets.survivorship: Point-in-time S&P 500 membership mask; names that left the index retain their history and their delisting path.

datasets.availability_rule: PANEL-F stamps every fact by SEC FILING AVAILABILITY (filed <= the decision calendar date), never by period end, and takes the latest filing available at that date per (cik, concept, period). Restatements filed later are therefore invisible to earlier slots.
datasets.survivorship: 237 delisted names retained. Aligned to sp500_pit_panel_v1 array for array; the 181-slot decision grid is VERIFIED equal to the book's at load, not assumed.

universes.rules: Certified R38 markets of r59 class COMMODITY_FUTURES with a finite return at t, at least 227 OWN sessions in the 252 grid slots ending t-1, and finite whole-curve open interest on at least 9 of every 10 own sessions in [t-274, t-2]. Own sessions are counted, never grid slots: a complete US series fails a grid-slot test whenever three US holidays fall in the window.

Certified COMMODITY_FUTURES markets with a finite return at t, at least 227 own sessions in the 252 grid slots ending t-1, and a finite annualised term-structure slope on at least 40 of the 63 grid slots ending t-2.
All 68 certified markets with a finite return at t, at least 227 own sessions in the 252 grid slots ending t-1, and positive volume on at least half of their own sessions in [t-253, t-2].

The 60 certified NON-FX markets with a finite return at t and at least 227 own sessions in the 252 grid slots ending t-1. The 8 certified FX_FUTURES markets DEFINE the dollar factor and are never scored, so no market can mechanically predict itself.

The 14 certified markets in R38 groups INTL_INDEX_FUTURES and INTL_INDEX_FUTURES_EMERGING with a finite return at t and at least 200 own sessions in the 252 grid slots ending t-1. The book is flat unless at least 10 markets are scored.

Securities that are S&P 500 members at t under the panel's own point-in-time membership mask, with a finite positive total-return price at t and a finite price at the t+1 entry, and at least 10 finite samples of opinc_to_assets among the 16 quarterly samples ending at t's own PANEL-F slot. MEASURED coverage of eligible members: mean 0.744, minimum 0.651 over the 136 decisions on which the four-year window exists.

review_order_rule: BINDING, and also the EXECUTION order, because a halted cell settles and counts to the burden just like a reviewed one. Ordered by ex-ante conviction so the strongest ideas pay the smallest denominator, with every declared variant reviewed AFTER its parent (w2_04 after w2_02; w2_10 after w2_09).

experiments.label: FUT_CURVE_HEDGING_CONCENTRATION_COMMODITY
experiments.hypothesis: Where a commodity market's open interest sits ON ITS CURVE, measured against that market's own 12-month norm, predicts the cross-section of 21-session commodity futures returns net of per-market and roll cost: the front-contract share of whole-curve open interest, averaged over [t-22, t-2] and z-scored against its own [t-253, t-2] history, then demeaned within economic group.
experiments.mechanism: Hedging pressure (Keynes/Hicks/Hirshleifer) concentrates in the nearby contract and the speculator who absorbs it is paid for it. Interest sitting unusually far FORWARD means thin nearby hedging demand and a thin premium; interest concentrated in the nearby means a fat one.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Partial rebalance lambda = 1/3 toward the rank-centred dollar-neutral target, masked to live markets and renormalised to UNIT GROSS. Frozen before measurement; set from FEATURE-SIDE turnover alone (measured 0.244 one-way, ceiling 0.40).

experiments.label: FUT_RISK_TRANSFER_CHURN_COMMODITY
experiments.hypothesis: Volume per unit of whole-curve open interest, averaged over [t-22, t-2], logged and demeaned within economic group, predicts the cross-section of 21-session commodity futures returns NEGATIVELY: long the slow-turning markets, short the fast-churning ones.
experiments.mechanism: Keynes-Hicks risk transfer. Open interest that turns over slowly is risk being HELD - hedgers transferring price risk to speculators who must be paid to hold it. Volume many times the open interest is short-horizon speculation among participants who transfer no risk, and the premium there is competed away. The ratio, not either leg, is the economic quantity.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance to the rank-centred dollar-neutral unit-gross target, no smoothing (measured feature-side turnover 0.343, ceiling 0.40).

experiments.label: FUT_BASIS_UNCERTAINTY_PREMIUM_COMMODITY
experiments.hypothesis: The SECOND moment of the futures curve predicts the cross-section of 21-session commodity returns: the log standard deviation of daily changes in the annualised term-structure slope over the 63 grid slots ending t-2, demeaned within economic group, is POSITIVELY related to subsequent return.
experiments.mechanism: Theory of storage. The convenience yield is the price of physical availability; when it is UNSTABLE, inventory is scarce and the holder of the nearby contract bears genuine stock-out risk that must be compensated. The estate has scored the LEVEL of the curve many times and its second moment never once.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance, no smoothing (measured feature-side turnover 0.191).

experiments.label: XA_RISK_TRANSFER_CHURN_ALL_MARKETS
experiments.hypothesis: The risk-transfer churn effect of W2-02 GENERALISES beyond commodities: volume per unit of the FRONT contract's open interest over [t-22, t-2], logged and demeaned within r59 asset class, predicts 21-session returns negatively across all 68 certified markets.
experiments.mechanism: The same Keynes-Hicks mechanism, asked where its premise differs: FX and rates dealers hedge too, but the hedger/speculator split is not the commodity one. A risk-transfer premium that exists only in commodities is a commodity fact; one that generalises is a futures fact.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance, no smoothing (measured feature-side turnover 0.295). Whole-curve open interest has 0% coverage outside commodities, so this cell uses the FRONT contract's open interest and demeans by asset class rather than economic group, which keeps the single-market groups in the book.

experiments.label: XA_FLOW_DRIVEN_WEEKLY_REVERSAL
experiments.hypothesis: A 5-session move made on abnormally HIGH volume reverses over the next 5 sessions and a move made on abnormally LOW volume does not: the volatility-scaled 5-session return over [t-6, t-2] MULTIPLIED by the clipped log ratio of 5-session to 64-session mean volume predicts 5-session cross-asset futures returns negatively.
experiments.mechanism: Campbell-Grossman-Wang / Grossman-Miller. A move on abnormally high volume is the market paying a liquidity provider to absorb an inventory imbalance, and it reverts; a move on low volume is information being priced, and it does not. The signed interaction states both halves in ONE parameter-free rule, so the hypothesis is falsifiable in a single test.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Partial rebalance lambda = 0.35, renormalised to unit gross. Frozen before measurement; without it the construction's feature-side turnover is 0.669 and the cell is structurally unregistrable against the 0.40 ceiling (measured with the rule: 0.257).

experiments.label: XA_DOLLAR_FUNDING_SLOW_DIFFUSION
experiments.hypothesis: A market's realised exposure to the dollar move that JUST HAPPENED keeps pricing after the move: the 252-session OLS beta of a market's return on a long-dollar basket (the negated mean of the 8 certified FX futures), multiplied by the dollar's own 21-session log move, predicts 21-session returns of the 60 non-FX markets negatively.
experiments.mechanism: Bruno-Shin global financial cycle. A stronger dollar tightens global funding and raises the cost of carrying dollar-priced inventory and hedges; the real-economy response - inventory, trade credit, EM funding - takes weeks, so the cross-section of dollar exposures keeps pricing the shock after it happened.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Partial rebalance lambda = 0.35 (measured feature-side turnover 0.221; 0.491 unsmoothed).

experiments.label: XA_COMPLEX_LEAVE_ONE_OUT_MOMENTUM
experiments.hypothesis: A market's PEERS' 12-2 trend, with the market's OWN return removed, predicts its next 21-session return: within each economic group of at least 3 scored members, the mean 12-2 log return of the other members, not demeaned.
experiments.mechanism: Slow diffusion of complex-level information (Hou's industry lead-lag). A supply or demand shock hits a whole complex - the energy curve, the grain board, the treasury strip - but each market prices it at its own speed because participants specialise by market, so the peers' trend still carries information the market's own trend has already discounted.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Full rebalance, no smoothing (measured feature-side turnover 0.215).

experiments.label: FUT_BETTING_AGAINST_VOLATILITY_INTL_INDEX
experiments.hypothesis: Risk-adjusted returns FALL with realised volatility across international equity index futures: ranking the 14 certified index markets on 252-session realised volatility and holding a risk-parity low-volatility leg against a risk-parity high-volatility leg earns a positive 21-session net return.
experiments.mechanism: Leverage aversion (Black 1972; Frazzini-Pedersen 2014, who document it in international equity index futures). Investors who cannot or will not lever express equity views by buying high-volatility markets instead of levering low-volatility ones, so risk-adjusted returns fall with volatility.
experiments.rebalance_rule: NOT a rank book. Split the scored markets at the cross-sectional MEDIAN volatility; the low-volatility leg takes weights proportional to 1/sigma summing to +0.5 and the high-volatility leg weights proportional to 1/sigma summing to -0.5. Unit gross, no leverage, no smoothing. The leg scaling is what keeps the book from being structurally short global equity beta, which a plain dollar-neutral rank book on a volatility score would be (measured feature-side turnover 0.128).

experiments.label: EQ_OPERATING_PROFITABILITY_MULTIYEAR_TREND
experiments.hypothesis: The FOUR-YEAR DIRECTION of operating profitability predicts 21-session S&P 500 excess return: the OLS slope of opinc_to_assets across the 16 quarterly point-in-time samples ending at t, long-only top 100 against the equal-weight eligible universe, net of 12.5 bp per side.
experiments.mechanism: Investors anchor on the latest quarter and underreact to the multi-year DIRECTION of operating profitability, which is far more persistent than any single quarter and predicts future profitability; the drift is the correction.
experiments.sample_start_rule: The book begins at 2015-04-07, the first decision at which the sixteen-quarter window EXISTS. PANEL-F starts at the discovery date itself, so on the first 45 slots no security can be scored; running from the grid's start would not measure a weak discovery, it would fill 45 of 77 discovery decisions with a book that holds nothing. Declared here, before measurement. Layers: D 32, V 59, L 43 decisions.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Equal-weight top 100, next-close entry (measured feature-side turnover 0.054).

experiments.label: EQ_OPERATING_PROFITABILITY_STABILITY
experiments.hypothesis: The STABILITY of operating profitability predicts 21-session S&P 500 excess return: the standard deviation of first differences across the same 16 quarterly point-in-time samples, held LONG in the most stable 100 names against the equal-weight eligible universe, net of 12.5 bp per side.
experiments.mechanism: Quality-minus-junk safety. Investors overpay for uncertain cash-flow streams (lottery demand) and underpay for predictable ones; the compensation shows up as a premium to stability. This is the SECOND moment of the same owned series whose FIRST moment W2-09 tests - two different economic claims, not two parameterisations of one.
experiments.sample_start_rule: Identical to W2-09: 2015-04-07, D 32 / V 59 / L 43 decisions.
experiments.rebalance_rule: Equal-weight top 100, next-close entry (measured feature-side turnover 0.070).
